Exploitability_explanation:: ✅ API call confirmed in `new_project/client/code/app/app.demo.js:L16`: `$(html).hide().appendTo('#chatlog').slideDown();`. The `html` variable is generated from a server-sent message and passed directly to a vulnerable jQuery DOM manipulation method without sanitization, matching the exploit criteria for version 1.7.

✅ API call confirmed in `lib/client/system/modules/socketstream.js:L95-102`: `$.ajax({ url: ..., dataType: 'script' ... });`. This is an explicit, reachable call to the vulnerable API pattern in the framework's core client-side code. The original assessment of 0% is incorrect as the vulnerable function is explicitly called.

✅ API call confirmed in `lib/client/system/modules/socketstream.js:L95-102`: `$.ajax({ url: ..., dataType: 'script' ... });`. The repository bundles and uses jQuery 1.8.0 with a direct call to the vulnerable `dataType: 'script'` parameter for on-demand code loading.

✅ API call confirmed in `new_project/client/code/app/app.demo.js:L16`: `$(html)`. jQuery 1.7 is vulnerable to XSS when passing untrusted HTML to the selector constructor. This usage exists in the default demo template provided by the framework.
